text:
Late last night, pet carriers stood out in your feedback, and we are sorry. You reached out because the handling of your pet's carrier felt careless and the service around boarding and arrival did not match what Aurelia Skyways should deliver. We take that seriously, and the Companion Animal Travel Desk is already looking at the full path from check-in through pickup to see where our process slipped.

Our desk coordinates animal care from booking through pickup, and that means every handoff should feel calm and controlled. The cabin team is trained to monitor animals during flight, check comfort, and keep watch for signs of stress. When something goes wrong with a carrier, the impact is bigger than the gear itself, because it affects trust, safety, and the whole travel experience. That is why we are reviewing the service notes, the desk ledger, and the coordination between the front counter, the ramp team, and the cabin staff. We want to know exactly where the gap happened so it can be corrected fast.

Please know that every animal receives patient attention from trained staff, and that standard is not optional. If a carrier was handled roughly, delayed, or set aside without proper care, that is not the service we aim to provide. We are also checking whether the handoff was recorded clearly and whether the updated care notes were shared without delay. Routine desk work should make travel smoother, not add stress, and we are tightening that part of the process now.

We cannot undo what you already went through, but we can address it directly and make sure the issue is not repeated. Your report has been flagged for follow-up, and the team is treating it as urgent. Thank you for calling this out and giving us the chance to respond. Companion Animal Travel Desk
